evidence_policy: This is an acceptance plan. Source code or a build does not establish browser pass. Each browser result must cite its actual recorded event or screenshot.

requirements.title: One dataset behind every tab (totals and brand list)
requirements.source_heading: A1. One dataset behind every tab (totals and brand list)
surfaces: By Item KPI strip and table

acceptance.expected: At the identical unfiltered SS26 / Flooring scope, Overview, By Item, Sales Mix and brand charts reconcile to $8.4M sales and 182,400 sales units.
Every brand view uses one canonical brand dictionary; style names Northport, Hillside and Seashell do not masquerade as brands.
Brand share uses each brand sales divided by the same scoped sales denominator; Woodland Reserve share matches across all three surfaces.
After a Category/Subcategory cut, the summary strip, table leaf sums, brand total and contribution shares reconcile under that same cut.
All quantities, sales, GM and stock are derived from the same synthetic ledger; rate totals recalculate from numerators/denominators rather than averaging percentages.
Synthetic source status remains visible; no generated value is represented as an actual F&D client fact.

requirements.title: Same product, one ID, one story
requirements.source_heading: A2. Same product, one ID, one story

acceptance.expected: Northport and all repeated products have exactly one stable canonical product ID across current visible tabs.
The same product sales, stock condition and growth story agree across Overview and By Item.
When both demand/stockout and relative underperformance apply, the explanation distinguishes them and does not present conflicting categorical labels.
Any ID crosswalk is explicit; matching descriptions alone do not fabricate product identity.
Watchlist alignment is recorded as deferred while C6 hides that concept.

requirements.title: Remove apparel and non-flooring leftovers
requirements.source_heading: A3. Remove apparel and non-flooring leftovers

acceptance.expected: No Footwear, Premium, Outlet or apparel category wording remains in the flooring cluster grid or commentary.
Grid row identities match the current selected flooring categories; an unselected Laminate row does not remain in a Hardwood / Engineered Hardwood / Bamboo scope.
Cluster labels are A–F.
Combination count is calculated as displayed row count times displayed cluster count; red-cell count is counted from those same cells and thresholds.
Changing category selection updates both the visible grid and its narrative count.

requirements.source_review_note: Hardcoded Footwear/Outlet/10-of-30 fallback removed. Widget now displays only the API-provided insight or omits it. Dynamic source/grid and browser verification remain separate.

requirements.title: Copy cleanup: double full stops and repeated insight text
requirements.source_heading: A4. Copy cleanup: double full stops and repeated insight text

acceptance.expected: Sentence case is used for narrative prose; brand/category proper names retain their correct case.
No doubled terminal full stop remains in rendered insight prose or its tooltip.
Each attribute chart has a metric/lens-specific insight or omits one; the identical generic product-type paragraph is not copied above every chart.
Quantified narrative values match the selected chart and scope.

requirements.source_review_note: Already-punctuated bullets now use joinInsightProse in KPI, Contribution and Hierarchy Pareto widgets. Weekly file is owned by root; shared AIStrip sentence casing is owned by source_build.

requirements.title: Watchlist counters do not add up
requirements.source_heading: A5. Watchlist counters do not add up

acceptance.expected: If the Watchlist is later made visible, mutually exclusive Critical + High + Watch counts equal the items-needing-attention headline.
Total Scanned is a separately computed larger population, not copied from each priority count.
No Watchlist entry is exposed in the current three-tab release.
Choose an individual Division option: the dropdown closes immediately.
The selected division is applied/displayed; dependent values follow the existing scope contract.
Reopen and use keyboard selection; the menu closes and focus returns predictably.

requirements.title: Netlify badge and header overlap content
requirements.source_heading: B2. Netlify badge and header overlap content

acceptance.expected: The preview contains no Powered by Netlify badge overlaying page content.
At 798 px width, the header decoration and top-right controls do not overlap the filter bar.
Check desktop and a narrower viewport; content and buttons remain reachable without horizontal page overflow.
Only branding/deployment chrome is changed; unrelated product controls remain clickable.

production_dependencies: A hosted preview badge may also require Netlify project configuration; local HTML/CSS removal alone is not proof of the hosted deployment state.

requirements.title: Narrative card text is clipped
requirements.source_heading: B3. Narrative card text is clipped

acceptance.expected: All three bullets in each card are fully readable, or text is cleanly truncated before a distinct Read More control.
Read More expands the correct narrative and the control does not cover the last visible line.
Expanded/collapsed and narrow layouts remain readable.

requirements.title: Load error and URL naming (deployment)
requirements.source_heading: B4. Load error and URL naming (deployment)

acceptance.expected: A direct Hindsight URL lands in Hindsight; initial loading has no error toast and no empty Decision Dashboard flash.
Canonical local route, document title, header and breadcrumb use Assort.
Old agentic-assort routes redirect compatibly so existing links still open the intended screen.
A direct reload of By Item and Sales Mix works.
Hosted site naming is verified separately when deployed; local naming does not claim that a remote Netlify project was renamed.

production_dependencies: Renaming the actual hosted Netlify site/address requires deployment project control; preserve an explicit pending external task if unavailable.

requirements.title: Replace per-object Ask Iris with one entry point
requirements.source_heading: C1. Replace per-object Ask Iris with one entry point

acceptance.expected: A context-aware header Iris control carries the current screen and filters.
Repeated literal Ask Iris text is removed from object controls; if contextual controls are retained, they are symbol-only with accessible names and correct object context.
No context button silently opens an unrelated chart or stale selection.
Keyboard activation, close and focus return remain usable.
Interpretation of the document ambiguity is explicit: its Expected line permits icon-only contextual buttons, while the issue text prefers one entry point.
The visible section heading is Summary.
The same section label is used by the demo walkthrough/script and accessible names.
No visible Season Scorecard title remains in the current app.

requirements.title: Replace hex store map with a table (and fix its copy)
requirements.source_heading: C3. Replace hex store map with a table (and fix its copy)

acceptance.expected: The honeycomb/map is removed and the original 45 store identities remain available in a sortable table.
The table shows Store, Store ID, Cluster A–F and colour-shaded ST% cells.
Each column sorts in both directions; numeric ST sorting is numeric and ties use stable store ID.
Search by store name/ID/cluster changes the result count; clearing search restores the same store population.
Narrative names actual A–F clusters and derives its highest/lowest store-average rates from the displayed source population; no Premium/Outlet wording remains.
ST% is an absolute rate calculated from synthetic units and supply/buy, never the original signed change values.
Click a store to open its side panel with the matching identity, cluster, sales, sales units, GM, stock and ST KPIs from the same source.
Close button, backdrop and Escape close the panel; focus enters the panel, stays within it and returns to the originating store control.
Loading, error/retry and no-search-results states remain explicit.
Desktop, 798 px and narrow viewports retain all table content and panel controls without page overflow.
Rate shading is labeled as a demo convention with definition TBC, not an approved F&D target.

requirements.title: Add R4 / R13 / R52, sales per sq ft and PLR baseline columns
requirements.source_heading: C4. Add R4 / R13 / R52, sales per sq ft and PLR baseline columns

acceptance.expected: R4, R13 and R52 columns are visible with synthetic values and an explicit definition TBC label.
Sales per sq ft is visible and labeled synthetic / definition TBC; it does not silently use selling-space productivity when the source is product area.
PLR baseline is visible next to LY and Plan where those comparison columns exist.
The Overview Summary exposes the same proposed period/baseline measures without claiming an original production PLR feed.
New fields flow into column chooser, sorting and actual workbook download where those controls already apply.
Period totals reconcile to their synthetic ledger definitions; one unrelated value is not relabeled for all three periods.

requirements.export_source_note: Optional metadata writes Data/Scope/Definitions. Numeric period values, raw sales sums, filtered input and grouped-header compatibility are independently parsed. Root owns grid filtering/download browser evidence and caller wiring.

requirements.title: Weekly chart: fit to screen with zoom
requirements.source_heading: C5. Weekly chart: fit to screen with zoom

acceptance.expected: All 26 season weeks fit the chart container without an initial horizontal scrollbar.
A zoom or brush/range control narrows the visible weeks and visibly shows the selected interval.
Reset restores all 26 weeks.
Metric, subgroup and weekly/monthly changes remain correctly bound and the chart remains accessible at narrow widths.

requirements.title: Hide the Watchlist tab for now
requirements.source_heading: C6. Hide the Watchlist tab for now

acceptance.expected: The visible primary tabs are exactly Overview, By Item and Sales Mix.
Watchlist is not moved into a Decisions tab or advertised elsewhere.
A saved direct Watchlist URL resolves safely without exposing an unvalidated day-one workflow.
Experimental Watchlist creation and decision-lifecycle mock-ups are absent from this priority release.

source_review_findings.finding: Largest-remainder allocation recomputed its shrinking residual bound.
source_review_findings.resolution: Fixed centrally by local_data; exact full and 45-store additive reconciliation now passes.

source_review_findings.finding: Duplicated full stops arose from joining already-punctuated insight bullets.
source_review_findings.resolution: Safe join helper now used in KPI, contribution, hierarchy Pareto and weekly widgets; shared insight prose uses sentence case.

source_review_findings.finding: Sales Mix exports used compact display strings and did not include scoped filter metadata.
source_review_findings.resolution: Shared workbook builder now supports numeric Data plus Scope and Definitions; root/source_build wired current callers and filtered/sorted leaf collection. Actual browser files still require parsing.

source_review_findings.finding: Category heatmap could relabel ST values as another metric.
source_review_findings.resolution: Latest priority source binds a disabled ST%-only selector and matching percent format.

source_review_findings.finding: Remaining product thumbnails visible in desktop screenshots still show apparel for flooring products.
source_review_findings.resolution: Latest ItemThumbnail source replaces canonical priority IDs with illustrative flooring swatches and a neutral material fallback. Fresh browser screenshot/alt-text validation remains pending.

source_review_findings.finding: Overview legend rounds Woodland Reserve share to 27%, while the source insight and Sales Mix show 27.4%.
source_review_findings.resolution: Underlying source agrees. Consistent one-decimal legend display was recommended to root; verify final presentation.

source_review_findings.finding: Sales Mix export filenames exposed reference season 74 while metadata named the SS26 plan.
source_review_findings.resolution: Latest source names Sales Mix exports explicitly SS26; By Item uses seasonCode SS26 and records plan and reference codes separately in Scope metadata.

current_coverage_note: The criteria below are the acceptance plan, not browser results. Current source/data and actual browser evidence are separated in priority-coverage-audit.json/md. Later user steering authorizes future structural work after priority completion; Section D remains outside this priority release.
